'''Wu Yican''' ({{zh|s=吴宜灿}}; born 1964) is a Chinese physicist specializing in nuclear neutron physics and application Technology. He works as a researcher and director of [[Hefei Institutes of Physical Science]]. He is also the director of Institute of Nuclear Energy Safety Technology, [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]].

==Education==
Wu was born in [[Susong County]], [[Anhui]] in 1964. He secondary studied at Chengji High School.<ref>{{cite news|author1=Fang Xiaoliang ({{lang|zh|方笑亮}})|url=http://www.ahssnews.com/system/2019/11/22/011591096.shtml |script-title=zh:程集中学81届校友吴宜灿当选中科院院士 |work=ahssnews.com |date=22 November 2019 |access-date=17 December 2019 |language=zh}}</ref> He received his bachelor's degree and master's degree from [[Xi'an Jiaotong University]] in 1985 and 1988, respectively. He earned his doctor's degree from the Institute of Plasma Physics, Chinese Academy of Sciences in 1992.

==Career==
After graduation, he was assigned to [[Hefei Institutes of Physical Science]]. He is a member of the Chinese Nuclear Society (CNS), Chinese Nuclear Physics Society (CNPS), Chinese Institute of Electronics, and China Society of Radiation Protection. He is a member of the Computational Medical Physics Working Group (CMPWG) of [[American Nuclear Society]] (ANS).

==Honours and awards==
* September 16, 2018 SOFT Innovation Prize<ref>{{cite news|author1=Han Tianqi ({{lang|zh|韩天琪}})|url=http://news.sciencenet.cn/htmlnews/2018/9/417683.shtm |script-title=zh:中国科学家吴宜灿获欧洲聚变核能创新奖 |work=sciencenet.cn |date=17 September 2018 |access-date=17 December 2019 |language=zh}}</ref>
* November 15, 2018 ANS FED Outstanding Achievement Award<ref>{{cite news|author1=Han Tianqi ({{lang|zh|韩天琪}})|url=http://news.sciencenet.cn/htmlnews/2018/11/420002.shtm |script-title=zh:吴宜灿研究员获美国核学会聚变核能杰出成就奖 |work=sciencenet.cn |date=November 16, 2018 |access-date=December 17, 2019 |language=zh}}</ref>
* March 17, 2019 Fellow of the [[International Atomic Energy Agency]] (INEA)<ref>{{cite news|author1=Hu Li ({{lang|zh|胡丽}})|author2=Han Tianqi ({{lang|zh|韩天琪}})|url=http://news.sciencenet.cn/htmlnews/2019/3/424080.shtm?id=424080 |script-title=zh:吴宜灿当选国际核能院院士 |work=sciencenet.cn |date=18 March 2019 |access-date=17 December 2019 |language=zh}}</ref>
* November 22, 2019 Member of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] (CAS)<ref>{{cite news|author1=He Fei ({{lang|zh|何飞}})|url=https://www.thepaper.cn/newsDetail_forward_5139018 |work=Thepaper|script-title=zh:祝贺宿松籍科学家吴宜灿当选中科院院士 |date=4 December 2019 |access-date=17 December 2019 |language=zh}}</ref>
